description:

No Grupo S2 , somos pioneiros em desenvolver marcas e produtos icônicos de footwear e lifestyle que se conectam com o agora. Nosso propósito é encantar o consumidor e marcar histórias .

A Redley , marca urbana que traduz liberdade, atitude e estilo de vida. Estar no time da Redley é uma oportunidade única para mergulhar no nosso universo e viver de perto a energia da nossa ALMA SOLAR .

Existimos para marcar histórias — venha viver a sua com a gente!

Missão da vaga:

Participar ativamente do planejamento do calendário de comunicação, desenvolvendo campanhas integradas e coordenando com áreas parceiras para assegurar alinhamento com as diretrizes da marca. Liderar frentes específicas de social media, sendo responsável pela excelência de execução e inovação constante. Garantir presença estratégica, engajamento consistente e resultados mensuráveis que fortaleçam o posicionamento da marca nas plataformas digitais.

  • Gerir e implementar estratégias de comunicação digital para diferentes públicos e plataformas.
  • Desenvolver, supervisionar e executar campanhas de mídia digital e PR em parceria com áreas criativas e comercial.
  • Planejar e gerenciar calendário de social media, garantindo consistência e alinhamento com lançamentos e campanhas.
  • Produzir e coordenar criação de conteúdo para redes sociais, desde conceituação até publicação.
  • Analisar métricas (engajamento, alcance, conversão) e produzir relatórios com insights e recomendações estratégicas.
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas para garantir mensagens alinhadas e consistência de marca.

Ensino Superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável experiência em Produção de conteúdo (copywriting, conceituação criativa), Análise de métricas (Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, social listening) e Comunicação digital e estratégias de social media.

  • Day Off no Aniversário – seu dia é para ser celebrado do jeito que você merece!
  • Vale-Transporte – garantimos a sua mobilidade até o trabalho
  • Vale Refeição de R$ 40,00 reais o dia/útil
  • Modelo Trabalho Híbrido

Acreditamos que mais do que vestir, as roupas nos ajudam a contar histórias. Aqui contamos histórias sobre pessoas de Alma Solar, que aproveitam cada momento da Vida, que transmitem boas energias. Pessoas que não se contentam com a rotina e deixam os dias mais leves, como um mergulho no mar, um rolé de skate, um passeio de bike.

Há 40 anos buscamos entender o espírito do nosso tempo e de cada tempo, conectados com o mundo e com a natureza ao nosso redor.

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

title: Manager, Marketing Operations Strategist
description:
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Manager, Marketing Operations to coordinate Toptal’s marketing initiatives and drive them to successful outcomes. This position plays a pivotal role in the organization - it blends strategic reputation and brand perception stewardship with hands‑on marketing operations enablement. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, marketing operations rigor, and the ability to manage sensitive customer feedback at scale.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders across Marketing Strategy, Growth Product, Revenue, Creative, and Events to ensure marketing operations are directly aligned with business needs. Your work will involve coordinating projects across product, brand, content, events, and creative operations, balancing analytical rigor with strong project management execution.

You will also own the end‑to‑end management of third‑party review platforms such as Trustpilot, G2, Clutch, and similar organizations. You will develop and execute strategies, processes, and communications that elevate Toptal’s external reputation while transforming customer feedback into actionable insights for Marketing and business leadership.

This role combines data‑driven marketing operations and reputation management, bringing together reporting and analysis with operational enablement. Through this work, you will help ensure Marketing operates at scale while continuously improving how the Toptal brand is represented and perceived externally.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Develop and implement customer experience communications strategies relative to third‑party organizations and among key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Project manage initiatives and projects across marketing functions, ensuring alignment with business needs, utilizing our in-house operations management tools.
  • Manage workflows, improve processes, and facilitate review cycles to deliver projects on time and with quality, ensuring that project management tools like Asana are reporting accurate and helpful information.
  • Perform regular and ad‑hoc analyses using SQL, Google Sheets, or other reporting tools to provide actionable insights and verify activities. Track, report, and measure the success of activities.
  • Provide thought leadership, strategic insight, and clear communication (written and verbal) to your team and the organization on the company’s marketing strategy.
  • Develop and implement cross‑functional communications plans and processes for customer feedback and assessments.
  • Write and present clear updates and progress reports that translate data into narratives for leadership and functional peers.
  • Build relationships and coordinate with third‑party organizations to provide information, analyze and interpret data and respond to inquiries.
  • Work with internal business leaders to respond to clients, social media, and other inquiries related to third‑party assessments.
  • Partner with executives and senior leaders to achieve successful outcomes through major Marketing initiatives that result in new offerings, enhanced infrastructure, and processes. Your ability to learn the business, partner with executives, develop recommendations, and act swiftly to drive to completion will be key to your success.
  • Be in constant communication with team members via Slack and Zoom.
  • Identify many optimizations and opportunities that you see relating to furthering the growth tactics, organizational dynamics, and talent capabilities of the Marketing team.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members within Marketing Operations.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 6-8 years of experience in marketing operations, project management, campaign execution, or comparable experience in consulting, strategy or a similar type of role where you leveraged extensive amounts of data to draw insights about potential customers and marketing strategies, and thus make decisions on the best path forward based on those insights.
  • Experience with TrustPilot, G2, Clutch and other review sites.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to document processes. Experience with project management tools, such as Asana, is preferred.
  • You have supported creative workflows, including intake, briefs, and quality assurance.
  • Experience managing social media channels is a plus.
  • A working knowledge of Google Sheets/Excel is required, while experience with SQL or Power BI is preferred.
  • You are process‑oriented, ensuring activities are scalable, documented, and repeatable. You thrive on process improvement and can support the adoption of new tools and operations; familiarity with process modeling or AI‑driven automation is a plus.
  • You are proactive and adaptable, thriving in fast‑paced, changing environments while keeping projects on track.
  • You collaborate effectively across teams, building trust and alignment, and you adopt a growth mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with impeccable grammar and a command of the English language. These skills are effectively utilized through collaboration tools like Slack and presentation tools like Slides.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • We’re looking for someone who will meticulously analyze and provide insightful feedback on all of the creative, copy, images, growth tactics, and other types of work output related to Marketing initiatives, not simply a high‑level strategist. We expect such reviews to be meaningful and to provide insightful feedback to all team members working on a given initiative.
  • You must be a world‑class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

description:
Structural Engineer - Entry to Junior Level

Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. The Rio de Janeiro Office is searching for a Civil Engineer, preferably with a Master’s Degree in Structural engineering, with 2 to 4 years’ industry experience to perform design services. The ideal candidate should have worked as an intern/co‑op or structural engineer in a team environment participating in the production and development of structural concepts, analysis and calculations, construction drawings, services and material specifications, construction support services, and field inspections.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News‑Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally. Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practice areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Development of structural analysis, design and detailing of concrete, steel, and timber structures
  • Finite element static and dynamic structural modeling and analysis of structures
  • Assist Senior Engineers with the preparation of design concepts, specifications, schedules, quantity and cost estimates
  • Prepare design calculations and check calculations
  • Coordinate detailed plan details with engineers and drafting technicians
  • Participate in field inspections, reports preparations and in projects of rehabilitation of waterfront structures
  • Works in cooperation with other disciplines on multi‑discipline projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s of Science in Civil Engineering is required
  • Master’s of Science in Structural Engineering as a differential
  • Entry level with related internship experience or up to 2 years of industry experience
  • Civil engineer License CREA‑RJ
  • Familiarity with either AutoCAD / MicroStation, SAP2000 and REVIT as a differential
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre‑employment (post‑offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800‑171

• Please provide cover letter and resume when applying.

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions® serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings. title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.

A day in the life

Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados.

Requirements

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • SQL e outras linguagens de programação.

Este cargo é ideal para quem deseja aplicar conhecimentos em finanças, economia ou engenharia em projetos com impacto social, atuando de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados.

Você terá sucesso se demonstrar:

  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização;

Você será acompanhado por profissionais experientes e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver em projetos reais, com espaço para assumir responsabilidades crescentes.

Como este cargo se encaixa na organização

A Unir é uma consultoria especializada na estruturação e acompanhamento de projetos de concessão e PPPs. O(a) analista júnior integra nosso núcleo técnico e contribui diretamente para a produção de entregas essenciais à nossa atuação — modelagens financeiras, análises de viabilidade e relatórios que apoiam decisões de clientes públicos e privados.

Responsabilidades

  • Confeccionar, com orientação, modelos econômico-financeiros de projetos de concessão e PPPs;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos baseados em análise de fluxo de caixa e indicadores de viabilidade;
  • Coletar, organizar e atualizar dados operacionais e econômicos para os modelos;
  • Realizar simulações de cenários e testes de sensibilidade financeira;
  • Apoiar a equipe técnica em reuniões internas e apresentações para clientes.

  • Graduação concluída em Economia, Administração, Finanças, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Também serão considerados(as) candidatos(as) com graduação em andamento nos últimos semestres, desde que com boa base técnica e disponibilidade para atuação em tempo integral;
  • Domínio de Excel (inclusive fórmulas financeiras e organização de planilhas);
  • Capacidade analítica, organização e clareza na comunicação escrita;
  • Interesse em concessões, finanças públicas, infraestrutura urbana e políticas públicas.

Diferenciais desejáveis (não eliminatórios):

  • Noções de VPL, TIR, WACC, CAPEX/OPEX;

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards

  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)

  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting

  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry

  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Executivo de Contas - Turismo (Rio de Janeiro)
description:
Overview

A história da BWT Operadora se cruza com a da Serra Verde Express, uma das mais importantes marcas do turismo do Brasil. Em 1997, o grupo de empresas familiares, liderado por Adonai Aires de Arruda, começou a operar o trem turístico da Serra do Mar Paranaense. Não demorou para visualizar uma oportunidade de diversificar seus negócios e ir além dos trilhos.

Com 14 anos de história, a BWT se destaca por sua atuação no turismo nacional e internacional, oferecendo uma ampla gama de produtos e serviços que atendem às necessidades e expectativas de seus clientes.

Hoje, a BWT está consolidada como uma das principais operadoras de turismo do país, reconhecida por sua excelência no atendimento, inovação constante e responsabilidade social.

Com matriz em Curitiba e escritórios em diversos estados, trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão para proporcionar experiências de viagem únicas e inesquecíveis.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada.

Buscamos um EXECUTIVO DE CONTAS, para:

  • Realizar a prospecção de novos clientes na região do RJ capital, interior e cidades da zona da mata mineira , identificando oportunidades de negócios e realizando visitas comerciais;
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes atuais, mantendo um relacionamento próximo e identificando possíveis melhorias nos serviços prestados;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas, de acordo com as necessidades e demandas dos clientes.
  • Negociar contratos e condições comerciais, visando fechar acordos vantajosos para ambas as partes.
  • Analisar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para o crescimento do negócio.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação estratégicos para aumentar a receita e a rentabilidade da empresa na região.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho da área comercial, propondo e implementando melhorias contínuas.
  • Participar de eventos e feiras do setor, representando a empresa e ampliando a rede de contatos.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas da empresa, como marketing e operações, para garantir a entrega de um serviço de qualidade aos clientes.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Turismo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área comercial, especialmente com prospecção e gestão de contas. Conhecimento de mercado e carteira de clientes ativa será um diferencial.
  • Habilidade em negociação e elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Conhecimento do mercado local (Rio de Janeiro e interior) e capacidade de identificar oportunidades de negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas comerciais frequentes.

description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.
  • Quality & Timeliness: Ensure all data is extracted in a timely manner and meets our high standards for data quality.
  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de “ser quem você é” nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica (ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

O Grupo Macro é um ecossistema de performance digital, com mais de 15 anos de atuação, que conecta tecnologia, dados, marketing e inteligência de gestão para transformar como grandes empresas vendem, cobram e se relacionam com seus clientes.

Somos parceiros de marcas como Vivo, TIM, SKY e Itaú, aplicando IA generativa, automação e criatividade para gerar resultados reais em escala.Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um ambiente de alta performance, inovação e impacto direto em projetos que alcançam milhões de pessoas todos os meses.

Descrição da vaga

Como analista de monetização júnior para um aplicativo de recompensas (rewards), você atuará na implementação e análise de estratégias para gerar receita, mantendo o engajamento dos usuários. Seu foco será em otimizar os modelos de monetização existentes, como publicidade, compras internas (in-app purchases) e assinaturas.

Como atuará:

  • Implementa modelos de monetização : Colabora na configuração e no teste de diferentes formas de gerar receita, como anúncios in-app (via plataformas como Google AdMob) e ofertas de compra dentro do aplicativo.
  • Analisa o desempenho : Monitora métricas-chave (KPIs), como receita média por usuário (ARPU), custo por instalação (CPI) e taxas de conversão. Você usará dados para entender o que está funcionando e o que precisa ser ajustado.
  • Otimiza a estratégia : Ajuda a identificar oportunidades para aumentar a receita sem comprometer a experiência do usuário. Em um aplicativo de recompensas, isso pode incluir equilibrar a frequência dos anúncios ou o valor das recompensas.
  • Colabora com outras equipes : Trabalha em conjunto com as equipes de produto, marketing e desenvolvimento para garantir que as estratégias de monetização estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do aplicativo e com o comportamento dos usuários .
  • Cria relatórios : Prepara relatórios básicos de desempenho para a equipe sênior, mostrando os resultados das iniciativas de monetização e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Monitora a concorrência : Pesquisa o que outros aplicativos de recompensas estão fazendo em termos de monetização para ajudar a identificar as melhores práticas.
Atenção: Vaga extensiva para pessoas com deficiência. ♿

Requisitos

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Finanças ou em áreas correlatas a Negócios, Marketing Digital ou Análise de Dados .

Para a posição júnior, é essencial ter bom raciocínio analítico , afinidade com números e disposição para aprender continuamente sobre métricas e ferramentas de monetização.

Outras características:

  • Mentalidade analítica : Capacidade de interpretar dados e métricas para tirar conclusões e fazer recomendações.
  • Noções de finanças : Entendimento de conceitos como receita, custo e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas : Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e relatórios, como Google Analytics, ou plataformas de monetização, como Google AdMob.
  • Proatividade : O analista júnior precisa ser curioso e proativo na busca por novas formas de melhorar os resultados.
  • Comunicação : Habilidade para comunicar de forma clara as análises e sugestões para a equipe.
  • Compreensão de comportamento do usuário : Entender como os usuários interagem com aplicativos de recompensa, o que os motiva e como a monetização pode afetar sua experiência

Overview

We are looking for a Content Manager with strong SEO skills to contribute to the success of our top performing betting websites on the Brazilian market. The role is based in Brazil with offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

About the role

As our content manager at Better Collective Brazil your key objective will be the coordination, production and optimization of content. You will become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team working in our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Your key objective will be the coordination, production, and SEO optimization of high class content that ranks in Google. You will become part of an international, highly skilled and dedicated team catering to various user groups, in the broad field of sports betting and iGaming. You will take ownership and responsibility of the websites and products you are working on.

  • Coordinate the production of content for several of our top websites and create editorial plan
  • Optimize content for SEO
  • Perform keyword studies and develop strategies to address different user groups
  • Create new content based on business and market priorities
  • Manage requests to freelancers/writers, proofread their work and provide feedback
  • Regularly monitor KPIs (rankings, traffic, conversion)
  • Keep an overview of legal and competitive changes on the market
  • Closely collaborate with our business development team in order to make sure we have the best deals in place with our partners
  • Make sure your products / sites have the best interface; you will be able to collaborate with our CRO/UX team to optimize and push engagement rate up
  • Make sure your sites are technically performing
  • Provide your own SEO insights to rank higher in Google

Qualifications

  • Familiar with betting and passionate about sports
  • Speak (and write) English fluently and Portuguese (native from Brasil)
  • Master’s degree within the fields of Digital Marketing, Communications, Digital Strategy etc.
  • Minimum 3 years relevant experience e.g. from a content role or in the field of digital marketing (including internships)
  • SEO editing skills, and flair for proofreading on a variety of topics
  • UX sensibility in web-products
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
  • WordPress CMS experience
  • Team player
  • Ability to handle multiple projects at once

What we offer

  • International environment
  • High responsibility job where you will be able to innovate
  • A varied everyday life in a fast-paced international business
  • A lot of great office perks such as snacks and social events
  • A professional yet casual working climate with very skilled, passionate and fun colleagues you can imagine
  • Hybrid policy

Hiring model: PJ

Your path to BC

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application.

About us

We are a global sports media group headquartered in Copenhagen, with 20+ offices around the world and more than 1100+ employees. With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. For people that love sports, working at Better Collective is an opportunity to work on something you are passionate about and make work purposeful and fun. For those not into sports, a strong sense of sportsmanship is woven into the organisation, creating a collaborative, supportive, and fun environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We strongly believe that diversity of experience and perspective leads to a better environment and better products. We hire for cultural growth and welcome everyone, regardless of background, ethnicity, age, religion, political beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or other characteristics.

description:
Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Post‑Match Duties

Operational Excellence & Development

Job Purpose

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) serves as the operational and administrative anchor of the Office of the Dean and is the primary front-facing representative for the College of Arts & Sciences. Reporting to the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, this role is responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, front office services, facilities coordination, vendor and procurement activities, and student staff supervision to ensure a professional, efficient, and well-coordinated Dean’s Office.

Supervisory Authority

  • Supervises front desk staff and work-study students assigned to the Office of the Dean
  • Responsible for scheduling, training, task assignment, and performance feedback for student and administrative support staff
  • Provides functional guidance to administrative staff supporting front office operations

Nature And Scope

The Administrative Operations Manager (Front Office) works closely with the Dean, Chief of Staff, Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration, associate deans, faculty, staff, students, visitors, vendors, and university service partners (e.g., Facilities, Procurement, IT). This role exercises independent judgment in managing administrative operations, resolving day-to-day issues, and coordinating resources to support executive leadership and college-wide operations.

Principal Accountabilities

Front Office & Executive Operations

  • Serve as the primary front office presence for the Office of the Dean, ensuring a professional, welcoming, and well-managed environment
  • Manage front desk operations, visitor reception, and daily office readiness
  • Coordinate administrative logistics for meetings, events, and executive activities within the Dean’s Office
  • Maintain consistent front office protocols and service standards

Administrative Operations & Workflow Management

  • Establish and maintain administrative procedures, workflows, and internal operating practices for the Office of the Dean
  • Manage document control, records management, and administrative filing systems
  • Draft, maintain, and update non-HR administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Coordinate internal communications and administrative scheduling within the Dean’s Office

Student & Administrative Support Oversight

  • Supervise work-study students and front desk staff, including scheduling, onboarding, task delegation, and time submission coordination
  • Ensure adequate front office coverage and operational continuity
  • Support administrative onboarding logistics for new staff (workspace readiness, access coordination, supplies), referring all HR-related actions to the HR Operations Coordinator

Facilities & Building Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facilities, maintenance, and building operations for the Office of the Dean
  • Coordinate building safety, space readiness, and maintenance requests
  • Monitor office infrastructure needs and elevate issues to Facilities Management as appropriate

Vendor, Procurement & Resource Management

  • Coordinate procurement of goods and services in accordance with university policies
  • Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and pricing coordination
  • Track contracts, service timelines, and vendor deliverables (non-legal review)
  • Maintain inventory, office supplies, and resource allocation for the Dean’s Office
  • Oversee procurement card (P-Card) activity, including transaction processing, reconciliation, and compliance with university procurement policies

Operational Partnership & Special Projects

  • Partner with the Chief of Staff on administrative initiatives, operational improvements, and special projects
  • Support the Assistant Dean for Finance & Administration with administrative coordination and operational reporting as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve front office efficiency, service delivery, and administrative consistency
  • Coordinates domestic and international travel arrangements for the Dean, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and adherence to university travel guidelines

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of administrative and office operations principles
  • Demonstrated ability to manage front office services in a complex academic environment
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
  • Strong vendor coordination and procurement management skills
  • Ability to supervise and develop student and administrative support staff
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and operate independently
  • Working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including Workday.
  • Proficiency with office productivity tools (Word, Excel, Outlook) and administrative systems

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, or a related field
  • 4–6 years of progressively responsible experience in administrative or operations management
  • Experience supporting executive offices or senior leadership preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

$55,000-$65,000

title: Product Specialist (Sports Medicine) - Rio de Janeiro
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Product Specialist to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people‑led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the company’s product portfolio, its partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject‑matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted. Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision‑making.
  • Provide data‑driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go‑to‑market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with distributors, partners, and end‑user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field‑based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance‑based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high‑growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long‑term career progression.

title: Engineer, Rotational / Aspire Program
description:
The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

  • Performs detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards, or coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • With the assistance and guidance of an experienced Surveyor during the survey rotation:
  • Visits vessels, marine structures, and manufacturers for routine survey activities.
  • Performs work that involves conventional surveying practices but may include moderately complex problem resolution and coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • Conduct research in support of ship and offshore-related classification and rule development.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • BS degree in a related engineering field, including civil, structural, ocean, marine, mechanical, electrical, or naval architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems.
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Obtain knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

The incumbent reports to the Director, Talent Management. This position does not have any direct reports.

title: Pore Pressure and Fracture Gradient & Geomechanics Specialist (PPFG)
description:
Role Synopsis

The central Western Hemisphere Pore Pressure and Geomechanics team located in Houston is looking for a professional specialist to join the Western Hemisphere central PPFG/Geomechanics team in Rio de Janeiro.

The successful candidate will support well planning and execution for Brazil, as well as work with the broader team supporting all of the Western Hemisphere. This team supports all of the Gulf of Mexico, Trinidad, and Western Hemisphere exploration (including Brazil and Canada) producing assets and exploration activities offshore. In addition, the team is becoming increasingly involved in appraisal and development work for Carbon Capture Utilization and Storage (CCUS) in the US. We work closely with our subsurface and wells teams both in the Western Hemisphere as well as globally to safely and optimally deliver wells for bp.

The Specialist is an integral member of the cross‑disciplinary well delivery teams and provides support for well planning and execution by developing geologically sound and compliant pore and fracture pressure forecasts and wellbore stability models. Is involved in all aspects of well planning from early concept, through detailed well planning, execution and post well analysis. During implementation the specialist also collaborates with the Real Time Collaboration Operations Center on pressure detection efforts and with subsurface, drilling, and completions to incorporate pore pressure and wellbore stability takeaways and understanding to safely and successfully implement the wells.

Primary Accountabilities

  • Pore Pressure and Fracture Pressure Forecasting: Is encouraged to integrate multiple types of indicators and observations in a geologic context to generate a pre‑drill pore pressure and fracture gradient (PPFG) forecast. This may include pressure from seismic velocities, offset well data such as measured pressures, connection gases, log derived pressures in shale, and basin models for building the pore pressure model and log data, drilling events/data, mini‑frac/leakoff test data, lost circulation events, impact of reservoir depletion and lithology variations to constrain fracture gradient and minimum stress.
  • Integration with the multi‑disciplinary well planning team to optimize pattern selection of drilling fluid type/weight, casing string composition, setting depths, potential geo‑hazards and mitigation techniques. Able to communicate technical work, risks and mitigations to partners ranging from the drilling team, Operations team, leadership, co‑owners and governmental regulators.
  • Operational Support for Pore Pressure Detection: Real‑time model calibration, kick analysis, gas and breathing analysis, losses investigations, interpretation of formation integrity tests. Responsible for communicating the updated PPFG model and forecast to the operations team and recommending potential mudweight or drilling strategy changes and pressure point locations.
  • Drillability Assessment: Work closely with wells to develop wellbore strengthening model and implementation plan for drilling through depleted reservoirs.
  • Wellbore stability analysis: Develop wellbore stability models to provide minimum mud weight recommendations. Emphasis on analysis and integration of data from logs, drilling data, cavings analysis, image and caliper log analysis.
  • Operational assessment: Contribute to Reservoir Design and Operating Limits, broaching analyses, zonal isolation assessment, alternate well design, abandonment deviation/risk assessments. Participate in risk assessments to represent PPFG, zonal isolation and broaching risks.
  • Participation in subsurface related non‑productive time (NPT) analyses and investigations.
  • Support development and implementation of a best‑in‑class PPFG and Geomechanics toolkit.
  • Represent BP externally at industry meetings and JIPs.
  • Mentor less experienced team members.

Education

Engineering, Science, Geoscience, Geomechanics or Mathematics.

Crucial Criteria

  • Vast experience in relevant oilfield (drilling PPFG/geomechanics) with operator or service company.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to distill complicated technical work to a variety of interested parties.
  • Ability to work with cross‑disciplinary teams and prioritize to deliver ambitious wells.
  • Familiar with PPFG, geomechanics, drilling and subsurface aspects of Well Planning and Execution.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Previous PPFG experience with an operator, ideally planning and performing Brazil pre‑salt wells; previous geomechanics experience such as wellbore stability and formation pressure integrity tests, strong geology and geophysics background and experience with well planning.
  • Experience generating pre‑drill PPFG forecasts for offshore wells in both development and exploration settings.
  • Awareness of Geology, Petrophysics, Basin Modelling, Processing Geophysics, Reservoir Geomechanics, Drilling Engineering, Rig Systems, and Well Control.
  • Software proficiency and coding capability (e.g., VBA, Python, Techlog and Petrel).

Why join us

At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and ambitious environment. We believe our team is strengthened by diversity and are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

We offer benefits ( to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for bp. Please be advised that we do not require any forms of payment or course by applicants to be considered for open positions.

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Preferred Qualifications
