description:
PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

Requisitos Técnicos

Escolaridade / Qualificação Desejada: Técnico em Eletrotécnica

  • Técnico em Eletrônica ou Eletroeletrônica
  • Técnico em Desenho de Projetos ou Técnico em Edificações (com experiência em projetos elétricos)
  • Technólogo em Sistemas Elétricos, Energias Renováveis ou Projetos Industriais
  • Desejável Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Engenharia Eletromecânica ou Engenharia de Energia.
  • Conhecimentos Avançados em softwares de cálculo e modelagem elétrica/mecânica (ex: Autocad, PLS‑CADD, MATLAB, AutoCAD, ferramentas de análise de estruturas).
  • Residir em Fortaleza - CE;
  • Nível avançado em PLS-CADD;
  • Nível intermediário em Excel.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde Unimed Nacional (empresa cobre 80%, colaborador 20%)
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós‑graduação)
  • TotalPass (academias)
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Seguro de Vida

Compromisso com a Diversidade

A NIP do Brasil valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Todas as candidaturas são bem‑vindas, independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente onde todos possam prosperar.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

Your profile

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Job description

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma analítica e estratégica na avaliação de risco de crédito, por meio da análise aprofundada de demonstrações financeiras, entendimento da dinâmica operacional e setorial dos clientes, leitura do cenário macroeconômico e das condições de mercado, assegurando decisões de crédito alinhadas à sustentabilidade financeira, rentabilidade e mitigação de riscos da Betunel.

Main responsibilities

Realizar análise econômico-financeira completa dos clientes, com leitura crítica de balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados, fluxo de caixa, endividamento, estrutura de capital, liquidez, rentabilidade e capacidade de geração de caixa;

Avaliar a capacidade de pagamento e de execução operacional dos clientes, considerando histórico de adimplência, carteira de contratos/obras, perfil de recebíveis (especialmente públicos), concentração de risco, garantias e exposição global de crédito;

Analisar o posicionamento do cliente no mercado, seu setor de atuação, nível de competitividade, dependência de contratos públicos ou privados, ciclo do negócio e sensibilidade a variações econômicas;

Monitorar o cenário macroeconômico e setorial (juros, inflação, crédito, investimentos em infraestrutura, orçamento público, funding bancário), avaliando impactos diretos na capacidade financeira dos clientes e no risco da carteira;

Calcular e revisar limites e necessidades de crédito com base na programação de vendas, volumes contratados, preços, exposição já concedida, garantias existentes e perfil de risco;

Propor atualizações na Política de Crédito, considerando mudanças econômicas, regulatórias, práticas de mercado, custos financeiros, execução de garantias e estratégias da concorrência;

Estruturar, aprimorar e operacionalizar modelos de análise de crédito, critérios de rating, segmentação de risco e instrumentos de mitigação;

Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de risco (aging, concentração, exposição, inadimplência, comportamento de pagamento);

Contribuir para a automação das análises, segurança das informações e uso de ferramentas analíticas e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas,
  • Conhecimento da dinâmica de diferentes fontes de recursos (capital próprio, crédito bancário, recebíveis, contratos públicos).
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanços, DRE, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros;
  • Conhecimento em finanças corporativas e matemática financeira;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de análise de crédito e gestão de risco;
  • Análise de mercado, tendências macro e microeconômicas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel;

  • Noções de legislação relacionada a crédito, garantias e execução.

  • Vivência em análise de demonstrações financeiras, avaliação de risco, leitura de mercado e acompanhamento de clientes;
  • Experiência com análise de concorrência, ambiente econômico e movimentações setoriais;

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO₂ while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care of Accounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You'll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically – structured, purpose‑driven, and comfortable switching between hands‑on tasks and higher‑level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month‑end and year‑end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash‑flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3‑5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards, IFRS, and multi‑entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR), and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Key Qualities

  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard‑working and hands‑on
  • Detail‑oriented and analytical, with a problem‑solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross‑border or fast‑growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil‑based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

  1. Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  3. Optional third interview
  4. Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  5. Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  6. Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. title: Senior Media Services Manager
description:
Senior Media Services Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Field Medical Advisor - Brazil
description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity

Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.

This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross‑functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross‑functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
  • Contribute to medical input in promotional and non‑promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
  • Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
  • Support investigator‑initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
  • Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
  • Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real‑world evidence and outcomes research projects.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM).
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, site initiation visits, and investigator engagement.
  • Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross‑functional teams, including non‑promotional content and internal scientific training.

Requirements

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 8‑10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
  • Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
  • Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross‑functional, and multicultural environment.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills

  • Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
  • Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Experience leading or supporting investigator‑initiated or real‑world evidence studies.
  • Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Why Syneos Health?

Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game‑changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

Se você respira tecnologia, tem experiência em campo e o brilho nos olhos para prospectar e construir parcerias duradouras, seu lugar é com a gente. Nosso Consultor de Soluções em Tecnologia é o profissional estratégico que conecta a tecnologia às necessidades reais de nossos clientes. Sua missão vai além da venda de produtos, transformando o conhecimento técnico em soluções inovadoras e personalizadas em segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia. Você será o elo que impulsiona o crescimento mútuo e solidifica parcerias, contribuindo ativamente para a excelência da SDE no mercado.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções técnicas: Entender a fundo as necessidades dos clientes para desenhar e apresentar soluções completas e integradas em nosso portfólio (segurança eletrônica, redes, comunicação e energia), realizando demonstrações e prestando consultoria especializada.
  • Gerenciar e expandir carteira de clientes: Atuar de forma proativa no desenvolvimento e manutenção de um relacionamento próximo com a carteira, identificando novas oportunidades e reativando clientes inativos através de uma abordagem técnica e assertiva.
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas de valor: Criar propostas comerciais e orçamentos detalhados e tecnicamente consistentes, negociando termos que gerem valor para o cliente e para a SDE, e otimizando o processo de vendas.
  • Manter-se atualizado e compartilhar conhecimento: Buscar constante aprimoramento sobre as tendências do mercado de tecnologia, produtos e normas técnicas, participando de treinamentos e certificações, e compartilhando esse conhecimento com a equipe e clientes.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

    • Segurança Eletrônica: CFTV (analógico/IP), controle de acesso (biometria, RFID), alarmes, sistemas de monitoramento.
    • Redes e Comunicação: Redes estruturadas (cabeamento, switches, roteadores), Wi‑Fi, PABX IP.
    • Energia: Noções de energia solar fotovoltaica, no‑breaks, estabilizadores, sistemas de alimentação ininterrupta.
  • Habilidade para interpretar projetos técnicos e diagramas.
  • Experiência com CRM ou ferramentas de gestão de vendas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Soft Skills

  • Curiosidade e Aprendizagem Contínua: Paixão por tecnologia e por se manter atualizado em um mercado dinâmico.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Habilidade para identificar problemas, analisar dados e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Comunicação Assertiva e Didática: Capacidade de explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.

  • Orientação para Resultados e Foco no Cliente: Impulso para superar metas, sempre com o cliente no centro das decisões.
  • Inteligência Emocional: Para lidar com desafios, negociações e construir relacionamentos.

Hard Skills Complementares

  • Certificações técnicas de fabricantes relevantes (ex: CFTV IP, redes Cisco/Ubiquiti, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo ou em andamento em cursos como Engenharia (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Controle e Automação), Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas afins.
  • Certificações: Certificações técnicas na área de segurança eletrônica, redes, ou energia solar serão consideradas um diferencial.

Experiência Profissional

  • Vendas técnicas ou consultivas em empresas de distribuição ou integração de tecnologia.
  • Instalação ou suporte técnico avançado em sistemas de segurança eletrônica, redes ou energia, com forte interface com clientes e/ou vendas.

Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients?

Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em administração de redes corporativas.

  • Experiência com equipamentos Cisco, Juniper, Datacom, Fortinet.

Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.
Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - LATAM
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.
  • *Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.
  • *Preferred location: Brazil (Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro); Mexico City

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities ;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.

*Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice to Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact should you require any accommodations.

All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

A diversidade e a inclusão são fundamentais para o nosso crescimento. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas para PCDs e grupos minorizados, pois acreditamos que, ao valorizar a diferença, criamos um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo.

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente? Junte-se ao Grupo Profarma!

title: Workday Financials Senior Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Howard is seeking a highly skilled Workday Financials Senior Analyst to support stability, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of the Workday Financials platform. This role serves as a key post-production resource within Finance Administration, combining deep functional expertise with technical Workday Financials know how, analytical and collaboration skills to ensure accurate financial processing, efficient workflows, and effective system adoption.

Supervisory Authority

This position does not have supervisory authority. Sole contributor.

Nature And Scope

This role is responsible for post-production support and optimization initiatives of Workday Financials, with functional coverage across Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Foundational Data Model (FDM), Projects, and Record-to-Report. The Senior Analyst owns the configuration and maintenance of accounting posting rules, custom validations, financial accounting business processes, and reporting solutions, and works closely with Accounting/Finance stakeholders and cross-functional partners to ensure Workday Financials aligns with accounting, reporting, and operational requirements.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Execute the day-to-day post-production support for Workday Financials, including enhancement and optimization, break/fix resolution, release management, and deployment of new features and functionality.
  • Lead functional analysis, design, configuration, testing, and delivery of Workday Financials solutions to support Finance Administration and institutional business needs.
  • Maintain and optimize accounting configurations, posting rules, validations, and related business processes to ensure accurate financial transactions and reporting.
  • Coordinate and lead system testing activities, including regression testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure system changes are production-ready and minimally disruptive.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to end-users on the effective use of Workday Financials, ensuring users are fully equipped to leverage the platform’s capabilities.
  • Lead system testing for new features, configurations, and system upgrades, ensuring seamless transition and minimal disruption to business processes.
  • Partner with subject matter experts and cross function teams to document requirements, develop use cases, and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Collaborate with Finance leadership and team members to support post-production road-mapping, continuous improvement initiatives, and timely delivery of system solutions.

Core Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize the financial accounting and reporting impact of system configurations and changes.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and deliver results under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to translate accounting and reporting requirements into effective system solutions.
  • An active an agile learner with a commitment to continuous improvement and the application of new knowledge to evolving institutional needs. An ability to stay updated with Workday features, tools, and best practices through continuous learning and training.
  • Demonstrated understanding of process reengineering and the design and implementation of business process workflows, approvals, and reporting enhancements.

Minimum Requirements

  • MBA, MIS, or a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, computer science or related field from an accredited University, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Workday certification or demonstrated proficiency in at least two Workday Financial Management areas: Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Expenses, Foundational Data Model (FDM), Projects, Record-to-Report. Candidates who do not currently hold required certification must obtain or demonstrate proficiency within twelve (12) months of employment.
  • Experience with Workday’s reporting tools, such as Report Writer.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain respectful, collaborative working relationships with staff, faculty, students, and stakeholders.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$120,000-$130,000

title: Workday Financials Senior Analyst, Record to Report
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Howard is seeking a highly skilled Workday Financials Senior Analyst – Record-to-Report (Lead) to support and enhance the University’s Record-to-Report (R2R) operations. This role provides advanced functional leadership across Workday Financials, Workiva, and other financial systems, with a focus on streamlining workflows, increasing automation, strengthening controls, and improving the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial close and reporting processes. The role serves as a key post‑production lead within Finance Administration, partnering closely with Accounting, Financial Reporting, and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, well‑governed financial systems and reporting solutions.

Supervisory Authority

This position does not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

This role serves as the functional lead for Record-to-Report within Workday Financials, with responsibility for post‑production support, optimization, and continuous improvement across the financial close, accounting, and reporting lifecycle. The Senior Analyst – R2R Lead owns the configurations, governance, and optimization of Record-to-Report related Workday Financials processes, including accounting posting rules, journal processing, reconciliations, validations, and reporting. The role also oversees the Workiva platform, ensuring effective integration with Workday Financials and alignment with financial reporting, close, and control requirements.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the functional lead for Record-to-Report operations within Workday Financials, supporting period‑end close, accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting processes.
  • Identify, design, and implement opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance automation, and improve efficiency across R2R processes. This includes improving data accuracy (governance) and enhancing the end‑user experience.
  • Lead functional analysis, design, configuration, testing, and delivery of Workday Financials reporting (dashboards and reports), including PRISM analytics strategies to support Finance Administration and institutional business needs.
  • Maintain and optimize accounting configurations, posting rules, validations, and related business processes to ensure accurate financial transactions and reporting.
  • Oversee the Workiva platform, including coordination of integrations with Workday Financials, support of financial statement preparation, and alignment with reporting and close processes.
  • Coordinate and lead system testing activities, including troubleshooting report‑related issues, regression testing and user acceptance testing (UAT), to ensure stakeholders reporting requirements are met.
  • Develop report writing standards, best practices, and management of financial report repository.
  • Partner with Accounting, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and cross‑functional stakeholders to document requirements, develop use cases, and ensure solutions align with accounting and reporting standards.
  • Support post‑production road‑mapping, continuous improvement initiatives, and timely delivery of system enhancements related to financial close and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize the financial accounting and reporting impact of system configurations and changes.
  • Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and deliver results under time‑sensitive conditions.
  • Deep understanding of Record-to-Report processes, including period‑end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Detail‑oriented, analytical, and proactive problem solver with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • An active an agile learner, able to apply new tools, features, and best practices to evolving financial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate accounting and reporting requirements into effective system configurations and automated solutions.

Minimum Requirements

  • MBA, MIS, or a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, computer science or related field from an accredited University, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Workday certification or demonstrated proficiency in Record-to-Report and at least one Workday Financial Management area (Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, or PRISM). Candidates who do not currently hold required certification must obtain or demonstrate proficiency within twelve (12) months of employment.
  • Experience with Workday’s reporting tools, such as Report Writer (Advance Report, Composite Report, PRISM).
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain respectful, collaborative working relationships with staff, faculty, students, and stakeholders.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$132,000-$142,000

description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)

  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling

description:
Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Rio de Janeiro)

Rio de Janeiro

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;

  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Sr. Energy Storage Project Development Team Leader

Locations: FULLY REMOTE - Brazil (Rio de Janeiro, Sau Paulo, and surrounding areas)

This is an opportunity to join a trailblazing BESS (Battery Energy Storage) company backed by top-tier private equity, leading the charge in utility-scale energy storage development, execution, and operations. With a rapidly expanding national footprint, and double digit GW portfolio including one of the largest fleets of grid-connected, standalone battery storage assets in the country.

These assets strengthen the grid by storing excess energy and delivering it during peak demand, storms, or outages. Fast and flexible, they provide critical grid services acting like modern power plants to support a more reliable, resilient energy system.

The Sr. Renewables BESS Development Manager will de-risk and take next generation battery storage projects through the full development lifecycle in Brazil. These are complex portfolios that require an intimate knowledge of the transmission interconnection and permitting as it relates to the project development process. A proven showcased by a proven track record of working through transmission auctions, ONS and EPE rules to get projects to NTP/COD in Brazil. This role will help lead and drive the commercial strategy in Brazil and represent the company's interest through manager relationships with Brazilian Partners.

They are committed to creating more renewable infrastructure solutions for the grid and are offering comprehensive compensation packages to their employees leading the drive to meet company goals. Other perks included a competitive base salary, open PTO policy, flex work hours, health benefits, the opportunity to work with a transparent Executive Leadership Team..and more.

  • Sr. Renewables BESS Project Development Leader - Lead greenfield utility-scale grid infrastructure development projects through the creation of development and project de-risking strategies

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Analista N2 Pleno

Empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade:
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP:
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conce sabe TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana).
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG.
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim, sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.
  • Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo.
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa.

Jornada / Modelo

  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial
